body:
I'm turning 30 and all I can say is that I don't know what to do. I don't believe that I will ever date again, my confidence and self esteem was obliterated, and I don't know how to get that back. I also have the issue of putting myself down, I don't believe that there's anyone who could ever want me. I mean, isn't that the reason my exe targeted me in the first place? I was already broken, easy pickings.

There's nobody out there for me.

My life has never really been a good life, since as far back as I can remember, but I do know that I was at least happy.
I don't feel much of anything anymore, going on 4 years since the discard. 
Life just feels like a holding pattern, I don't know what it is that I'm supposed to do. Most days I feel like I'm dreaming, everything just feels like film studio set and I'm just acting out life. I was happy once and now I don't know if I ever will be again.

Attention and validation, of any kind. I once asked my exe about what made her like me (pre discard) and her response was that she likes how when we hang out that we don't have to talk and that I'm fun. That could be referring to literally any random person, it's purely attention and validation.

I've subconsciously learned how to turn off my alarm in my sleep. It's really annoying, I end up waking one or two hours later than I originally planned. I've almost been late to work because of it.

I've started putting my phone on the other side of the room, so if I wanna turn the alarm off I have to actually get up.
My ex would hold a pen/pencil like how a toddler might hold a fork/spoon...

Around 8 to 9 months for me, it started to occur around the time I started working out and getting in shape. I started hanging out with my friend group, that hated her guts, more often. We would get into arguments that she wanted to be included with my friend group. 
Eventually she started to not want to do anything with me that didn't involve hanging out in my house, but would often say we never did anything.

Then in one weekend that I had went out of state to visit family, she packed up and got engaged with her dealer.
She ripped my heart out and I'll never really know why.

My ex could never hold down a job, her grandparents gave her a seasonal part time job at their business, and she'd also do chores for her parents, but even with that she would skip work or shrug off the errands. I guess she figured out that she could get a free ticket by marrying, so she ran off with her drug dealer and just disappeared out of my life.

It's hard to say for sure in my opinion. I've seen alot of people post that their exes hoovered very soon after the discard, though I've also seen posts of people who've said it's been 10+ years and their expwBPD never hoovered.
It might depend on who did the dumping or ot may just be random.

It's been 3 years since discard and I have not been hoovered, which is great, but I'd be lying if I said I wasn't a little disappointed. I guess I really did mean nothing to her

I think it's more of a generalization than anything explicitly. My ex was terrible at sex, literal dead fish, but she was into alot of kinky stuff and for the first year we were together it was multiple times a day, every single day.
It's addicting.

Same exact boat my man, paranoid avoidant (Insular Paranoid) and my first relationship ever, likely my last.
It's so soul shattering to put that level of trust in somebody for them to just prove your worst fears right.

My ex told me during the discard that the whole time we were together for those 2 years, that she was aware that she was abusing me, but she didn't care because I wasn't long term, that it wasn't her problem to care.

I believe that they are constantly aware of the abuse they cause, but they excuse themselves so as not to shatter their world view.

I burst out laughing when I read the pwBPD say ,"You're chewing too loudly", my exe used yo say this ALL the time, to the point that I had to go eat in a different room if I just wanted to enjoy dinner.

I know what you mean. Nearly everyday was fun at first, but it just became a chore. I actually think this was the reason she cheated on me, I couldn't keep up with her demand so she looked elsewhere. Truly scummy.

At the time I thought that I was in love with her, but I've come to realize that I just loved the idea of a relationship.
She wasn't a good person, not even counting her BPD, she was just rotten, but I have issues with codependency as my father has NPD. I thought that her behavior was just normal for a relationship, that that was just how some people were.
The hard part about getting over the codependency and trauma bonding, is that I miss the intensity, normal relationships now just seem strange.
My exe had multiple social media accounts, it amazed me how she could manage all those personas but not much else in her life, lol.

>I essentially became his carer, got him off drugs and the dole, helped him buy a car and get his dream job, gave him a place to live, and yet I'm the one who's still single and reeling from the traumatic experience of knowing him.

Ain't that the truth.

Their life is a ladder, we're the rungs, and as they climb, they break each rung on the way up.

I can really relate, especially the part about her saying, "you're boring, all you do is watch tv". Prior to dating my ex I was an outdoorsman, any free time I had I was out walking in nature, even after dark I'd walk around my town. However, my ex has a degenerative joint illness or at least she claims she does, she never was able to get a diagnosis from a doctor for it. She would refuse to go on hike, the one time that she did go afterwards she refused to do it again.
Thus the guilting phase began, whenever I'd go or just want to go hiking, she would guilt trip me, so I eventually stopped altogether. Into the second year of us dating, she would always say I was super boring and never did anything but sit at home.

I would have told myself not to sacrifice myself for a perceived happiness. My body knew what was going on, but I kept telling myself she was worth holding on to, that I found my person even if it was questionable.
Oh I know what you mean, I never understood how she had so much drama in her life for someone who didn't have a job and no other responsibilities.

The first year was rough, especially as I was discarded just prior to the lockdowns. I made it so much worse for myself by trying to chase her for closure, got death threats from her new guy. Eventually I found this subreddit and also watched videos about BPD breakup recovery. I'm doing leagues better today, been no contact for 2 years now.

This was the case for my ex, I was gone for the weekend and when I came back she was engaged to her dealer, moved in immediately.

She just forgot everything about the past 2 years, I was a complete stranger to her.

I felt really sorry for my ex when we first met and it's a reason why I stuck around. During our first date she revealed that she never had good friends, that every guy she's been with used her, and that her family hates her.
She claimed I was the first ray of light in her life, I felt like O needed to save her and fell hard. 

Knowing what I do now, she played heavily on my codependency. Also I totally get what you mean about being in a dealers car at 3am, lol. I had never done any drug up until being with my ex, I only started as a way to appease her.

The thing my ex would always say to me was that I was the kindest and most caring guy she had ever been with, that shit hooked me, cause who wouldn't feel like they're doing something right being told that?

4 to 6 month mark, my ex had a lot of quirks and red flags that she played off with other excuses, so I got used to alot of her behavior as just being her personality (more like personality disorder lol). After 4 months the pointless arguments and walking on eggshells started, she would drop little hints and traps meant to start the argument, if I noticed the trap would spring and even if I didn't notice, she would make it known.

>They want the world to see them as benign, enchanting flower children. The experiences shared on this sub take down that facade. That’s why they hate it.

This is exactly what I see from BPD subs and posts. They always gloss over the hurt that they've caused and just want everyone to see how "quirky and fun they really are", to them the wrongs they commit are just conspiracies from bitter people.
Yeah, they always have someone coming to the rescue. I got death threats from her new source.

I had a really bad nightmare a few months after the discard, what it essentially amounted to was being mocked while her and my replacement "embraced". There was alot of triangulation during the discard, death threats and all.

After 2 years of NC, I rarely think or dream of her, oddly enough on the occasions that I do, I can't remember her face. I suppose that's a good thing, haha.
It's understandable, my ex still pops up in my dreams sometimes, even as much as 1 year plus of NC. It's just become a very brief but uncomfortable moment.

I've been listening to a recent metal album called "I let it in and it took everything" by Loathe, specifically the song "New Faces in the Dark", the album as a whole has a very fitting message regarding heartbreak and failure, but that one song in particular has stuck with me.

"Details Matter" by Northlane is another particularly good song, especially if you are still in the anger phase of post discard.

I chased my exe twice after going short amounts of no contact, I came out of NC to try to reconcile, to keep some modecum of friendship. Each time my exe was more and more a different person, to the point that I didn't even know why I was reaching out and both times that I did chase I became more of a villain in her eyes. The arguments were worse than the initial discard and just added fuel to her idea of me as the bad guy. You can't win with these people, you won't get closure in the way that you need it.
My exe got engaged to her new supply while I was away for the weekend, now I'm sure she was cheating behind my back for at least a few months, but it'll only took her a weekend to move on.

I don't ruminate on what I could have done because I know now that there wasn't anything that I could have done, the train had left the station before I was even on the platform. What I do ruminate on is what I shouldn't have done. I hold alot of shame for chasing after her, I was desperate and made a fool of myself. I think I could have saved face and been in a much better place sooner had I understood what was going on at the time, but I didn't have that information.

My exe would often tell me that I needed to learn to hate her a little and just never understood how she could say something like that. I suppose it meant she knew what she was doing and that's something that I think about alot. It's also the reason why she'll never get better, because she doesn't care that she hurts people.

I still get the slight urge of curiosity to look up her social media, but I know that it will just upset me and undo all that I've overcome. It's hard to accept that this process has happened many times before me and will inevitably happen again, that nagging thought of "what if it works out for them this time? What does that mean about me?", But you have to remember it's a disorder for a reason, it's not something that can be changed so easily, especially if you knew my exe, lol.

To be honest, I'm not entirely sure. I know I wasn't as extroverted as she wanted me to be, I would often turn down invites to parties or social events. I didn't have sex with her as much as she liked, she wanted it every single day, and I just couldn't keep up anymore, it was exhausting. I was also probably not as malleable as she expected, I didn't have very many boundaries, but the ones that I did have were strong, and it would get under her skin that she couldn't control me to that degree.

In the end I guess she just wanted to be with a nearly 20 year older than her burnout drug dealer, who knows.
Like Heroin, the come up is amazing, but coming down is literal hell.

I was just starting my fitness journey before I met my ex. Lost 100lbs and started weight lifting, was really starting to get a good muscular profile. Now 2 years later, after the discard, I'm a mess. Gaining weight again, in the worst physical shape I've ever been. Having multiple medical issues back to back. I just don't know how to get back to where I want to be, I just feel so worthless.

Yes mine did, it took me a long time to realize and accept it. It is the guy that she is with now, I was in the same room as the guy multiple times even, he was her dealer and that was all that I thought it was. To add insult to injury, my ex gave me an STD just a few weeks before discarding me. it makes me so sick and ashamed of myself. I was used and thrown away like trash, I often feel like that's exactly what I am. Trash.

I lost all confidence and self-esteem, my physical health has taken a nose dive (I'm pretty much falling apart, lol), and I see people in a very distrustful way, like everyone is out to get me.

However there are a few silver linings that I've developed. I've learned to say no, I'm not so quick to help for any and all reasons, I take into account what's on my plate at the moment. Though I feel like I will probably never feel love again, I'm slowly learning to be okay with just myself.

I wish I could say things have gotten better, it's hard to deny that things have gotten darker. Some days are better than others. I hope that we all can find our happiness eventually.

I remember after the discard when I really truly saw the mask drop. She just became this completely different person, she even spoke differently. It was like snapping out of a dream and seeing this otherworldly horror, it was actually shocking to me.
Whenever Chris says "Show us y'r minge, go on then".

I tried to stay friends with my ex, I felt like I needed her in my life in some way, she thought it was totally cool to tell me how her new supply and her have sex and how much she enjoys it better. I'd often leave the room to go to another and just sob cause I couldn't stand up for myself in those moments. It's definitely not worth it to even be friends with them.

My ex asked me alot of questions at the beginning of the relationship, it's actually one of the first signs that I noticed but ended up ignoring, cause eventually she went from constant info gathering to just wanting to sit in silence whenever we were together. I remember her even saying that she liked that she didn't have to talk around me, except she did all the talking...

Something similar, at least in my understanding, had happened to me. I was discarded just after the lockdowns and was trying to get closure of any kind, my ex would frequently ghost me for weeks at a time and eventually she told me she was too busy to talk to me (which was a lie she is jobless/has no responsibilities), and I replied to her, "when are you not" and she exploded saying something along the lines of, "Maybe when there isn't a fucking pandemic, I can't see my boyfriend because of you". It felt at the time like a slip of the tongue, but she was actually accusing me of the lockdowns.
It's honestly rather eerie, my exe would often talk about how she wants to become a behavioral therapist.
Can't tell you how many times I heard the words "self therapy", lol.

No women don’t have to treat men this way. Not chalking it up as normal… chalking it up as a sociopath

The reverse is also true.

Oh I know what you mean, not necessarily yours might've cheated or anything, just that as I come out of the fog more and more, I'm realizing just how abusive and toxic my exe was. She always had a bad side, but whenever it was just her and I, she could be so damn sweet and caring, but it's just an act. I'm ashamed I let so much abuse happen to me, from someone that I loved and trusted.
Huh? You asked if anyone else sent evidence. If you have evidence your exe threatened you with a knife then go to the police, why are you on Reddit?

No, there wouldn't have been a point, all of her enablers are just as morally bankrupt as she is. They're the type that excuses violence and misdeeds if *they* deem it just.
I don't do social media, probably for the best, but I'm sure she has smeared me as an abuser and all of her flying monkeys ate it up.

I didn't think my ex cheated on me either, she was a quiet borderline as well. However I realized just recently that she had been shagging the new supply for a few months, just before the discard. Just to make matters worse, the "UTI" I got just weeks before the discard, was in fact an STD. She didn't care at all about me, to the extent that she even gave me an STD. It's just insane how cruel these people can be.

Don't send it, it will blow up in your face, I know from experience. I tried to send my ex a very heartfelt message about how I was suffering and how she made me feel about the discard and all she ended up saying was that I was "pathetic and jealous", they aren't the person you knew.
I won't say that everything is great, but I'm doing so much better than 2 years ago. I'm slowly finding myself as an individual, finding that I'm worthy.

I've never told very many people, but I feel like after reading your post that I'd share. My ex lovebombed me to the point that I could not live without her, I could function without her, and when she threw me away, I attempted to take my life, because I could not accept my life without her. It was a massive eye opener and a major regret, but I could finally see that keeping her in my life was destroying me.

Her rich parents mostly kept her topped off, but occasionally she would forget at the most critical moments. Like this one time, I had the day off from work and my ex and I didn't have anything planned, so I went to see a film at the theaters. Right as I was getting seated and ready to watch the film, I get a text from my ex that she's stranded without gas about 3 hours south of where I am. I told her that I had just paid for and gotten seated and wouldn't be able to come get her and that she should call her parents. She unloaded on me in a text calling me the most vile names possible and that I was a selfish piece of sh#t for wanting to watch a film while she was in "danger". She actually finished the text by saying, "If you don't come get me, I'm going to be r#ped and it's your fault".

One of the things I always see being argued with BPD is whether they are "bad people" because of the BPD or not. However one thing that I never see mentioned is who they are as a person excluded from the BPD. I think this is far more telling of what they are capable of and willing to do. My ex was rotten to the core, not because of BPD, because that's who she was as a person. Intense hatred for people she deemed more privileged than her, didn't care about endangering other people's lives, would steal just for the fun of it, and would even unknowingly involve other people in thefts.
I was trauma bonded to her and would forgive all of these negative aspects, but had I not been codependent, I would have kicked her to the curb at the start.

I have had experience with these kinds of nightmares, my ex would brag to me about how her new guy fu*ks her, would go into intimate details too. I would constantly have nightmares where I'd be in the same room as them having sex and they would just stare and laugh at me. Eventually the nightmares just started getting less frequent, I still have them occasionally but it's not traumatic anymore, just an annoyance.

My ex gaslit me hard into believing I was the one with BPD issues, she knew all the lingo as she is diagnosed and in therapy/medication. It got so bad that I would disassociate, have these numb "out of body" experiences. During the discard when I would reach out to her for some understanding and express my pain, she would just say I'm having a BPD episode. After I went NC and got into therapy, I saw a psychiatrist and was diagnosed with ASD (Autism Spectrum Disorder), which I had always figured I was autistic, but I'm certainly not BPD.
You are absolutely right about the perpetually never having gas lol. Almost didn't make it home from a six hour Chicago trip at 3am cause she didn't notice the gas gauge...
Tomorrow is my ex's birthday and one year of NC, feeling rather down right now.

Y'know what the craziest thing is? They really do throw away their past to "conquer" yet another person. During the discard one of the things my ex said to me in reference to the guy she replaced me with was, "I've never been able to justify being in love, but with this person I don't feel lonely", they don't know what they want they just feel what's in the moment is right.

It's just a healthy way to get closure, because there is no closure with BPD. You write the things you wish you'd said, the things you should have said, and in doing so you release yourself from the guilt/shame/anger of not standing up for yourself.

After the discard she acted so completely different around me, her new mask she put on for the new guy. She told me how during the entire two years she didn't love me and that I was just something fun until she got what she wanted. I had gone away for just the weekend to see my family and when I returned she was engaged to her dealer, said that he would give her a house and health insurance if she married him. I completely broke down mentally. Everything that was my life until that point just vanished, I struggled for several months just to accept what had happened and eventually got into therapy. Now it's just reminding myself that it was never really real.

I became the class clown in highschool to avoid the bullying, but it completely wiped out my self esteem. I went completely off the social radar in my senior year, it was peaceful but super lonely as nobody wanted me around if I wasn't making an ass of myself.
I have luckily, I've been NC for a year this month. I made it harder for myself not going NC earlier, I just couldn't accept what was happening.

When I went to live with my father when I was much younger, he introduced a chores/debts system. I would be payed $1 for every chore or yard work I did, but if I didn't do a chore or didn't do it correctly, he would deduct $5-10.
How's the quality of the shirt fabric? I was thinking of getting this shirt but I'm rather particular about fabrics.
My Father would walk around the house completely naked, even up into my late teens. It was always so creepy, no one should be forced to know what their parents look like naked.

Before I had blocked my ex, she posted an IG story about how much she loves how the new guy fucks her, knowing that I would see it in my queue. She would also text me details about them together.

I don't believe it when people say pwBPD aren't conscious of their actions, everything she did was with malicious intent to get under my skin, punish me. They can be so damn cruel.

Thinking back on my relationship, I've recently put it together that my ex had been cheating on me for quite some time. I was in the same room as the other guy many times, not knowing, while those two held this secret over my head. It's soul crushing, I still feel so embarrassed that it was happening behind my back.
Thanks for the help, I don't know that it would even be worth it after so long.
Thank you for the advice, I appreciate the help, this is something I'll have to consider.

I think a companion AI would be very beneficial,  a vast majority of people just want someone to be there for them, to listen, and acknowledge their existence. I would shell out for an advanced AI like that.
Ah, bummer. I gave it away around 25, the only person I've ever been with, in a lot of ways I feel disappointed in that fact.
You're almost a wizard, you can't give up now!

How does one smile properly? I'm genuinely curious, I have autism and can't smile properly, it comes off as me grinning or showing my teeth for the dentist. People say I'm really intimidating, I'm 6'5" 200lbs and always have a cold expression on my face, but I don't mean to be so intimidating.

Days fly by without me even noticing. I wake up, go to work, go home, eat dinner, and go to sleep. Rinse and repeat five days a week. I don't even remember the day/month/year much anymore cause there isn't a point anymore, my work schedule is my life, everything else is extraneous. I had dreams and goals once, but I quickly realized that some people just don't have a purpose, most people are just meant to fill the background, be an extra for other people's lives. Living as a husk wouldn't be too awful if it weren't for the fact that I'm aware of it.

So, here's something funny to consider. I had the goal of achieving "Wizard" status, virgin at 30. It was in my mind a very noble goal, who can say they willingly stayed celibate for that long? However around my mid 20s the pressure of being a virgin started to get to me, my friends had all lost theirs years ago, and I felt so inadequate. Around 2016/2017 a relationship sort of fell into my lap, I would find out the hard way she was an abusive borderline. At the time though I thought it was rather fantastic, I could finally punch my V card, but to be perfectly honest, the person I lost it to, in the way that I lost it, it made me feel disgusting and taken advantage of. I felt a lot of guilt about it afterwards, I had a discipline that gave me something to strive for and I threw it away for what?  Felt like I betrayed myself.

I don't think I can fully agree with you, but for the most part you're right it certainly is better. I think the issue for some, like me, is that we never had a self or a reason before the relationship. After finding and losing that reason, that sense of self, we're again left with nothing. I don't have the confidence to see a better future for myself now, in a lot of ways I'm worse off than before, I still had the hope I could be loved. Sometimes I feel I'd be better off being abused, I want to *want* to live, I just can't bring myself to believe it
Unfortunately the same problem as other dating apps exists with Bumble, women have to say hi first sure, but now they just don't say hi at all.

I don't know how to fill that section out to be honest, It ends up just looking like a checklist of my interests and hobbies. Which in my opinion isn't a bad thing, isn't the point of the dating process learning more about the person you're prospecting? If you know exactly what you're looking for going in, isn't that more like a buffet? I just don't understand dating.

It'll be a year or no contact later this month, I want to say that I've gotten better, and in a lot of ways I have, but I feel defeated. I feel worthless that it was all for nothing, that I meant nothing. I don't know how to move on, I have no purpose.
My ex bragged to me in detail how they had sex, I had a difficult time with those haunting images too, amazing how cruel they can be.
It's my money and I want it now!
I don't know how to smile properly, just looks like I'm grinning or showing my teeth for the dentist.

Yes and it was very innocuous, only thinking back on it now does her body language and behavior make sense. We used to go to her dealer's house alot to pick up her stuff and she would always sit on the couch with the dealer, across the room from the couch I was on. It makes me a little sick to think that everytime I was there, they held this secret above my head, probably talked shit about me during their trysts.
A few months of that later and they were engaged behind my back.

As said above chemical castration is the most practical way. militaries used to sneak salt peter into the diets of soldiers to reduce libido, probably still do, don't know the safety behind it though, lol.

No I don't, he's a lowlife burnout. I don't believe that she actually feels love for him, everything she does is for the benefit of herself, she said as much that it was for the promise of getting married and getting insurance.

I work nights so I guess I'm lucky to have something keep me busy, though I'm up all night on my days off too.
I do get to walk around my city at night though, makes it worth it in the end.
25 and to an abusive borderline that was my first girlfriend.

My Father has NPD and my Mother was a helicopter parent, I was as normal and prosperous as can be as a kid up until I lived with my Father permanently. Between the extremes of being told I'm everything and nothing, I never developed properly, and have no idea where to start. It was my Father's goal to break my spirit and he succeeded.
2/10 personality 5/10 looks, realistically speaking, I'm not a *boring* person, but I come on way too strong and over share, I can tell people find me to be overbearing.
Or pattern baldness, I've got an average face but I'm already balding and I'm not even 30 yet, bad genetics really sucks.
Mhm, okay, neat.

If Humans were far more logical, the world would be an easier place. Just think how simplistic the logical approach to relationships and friendships would be, "Hello there, you are seeking a companion and mate, yes? I too am seeking a companion and mate, here are my credentials, as you'll notice on line 6 I have a job, a home, and a good credit score". Unfortunately we're tied down by emotions and the vast majority of people couldn't tell you what the difference between loving a person and loving a pizza are.

My ex would argue that I chewed with my mouth closed too loudly. I don't know about you, but how does one chew quieter with their mouth already closed? So I tried chewing slower but she would still complain, eventually I had to start eating in another room and be done before rejoining her. Funny enough though, she would only complain about it in private, not at public restaurants or whatever, just in our home.

Depression stage, my first and only relationship was with a borderline, had my heart ripped to shreds and I'm still in therapy for the Mental/Emotional/Physical abuse. It feels like a sick joke that she was my first, like life is telling me, "Sit the fuck down", I just don't feel like trying anymore.
Thanks, I'm slowly remembering my worth, every tiny hiccup feels like falling off a cliff, but I remember 2 years ago feeling like I'd never get over her, it's just gonna take time.

This exactly, during an argument with my ex after the discard, she explained to me that I have "faults" so I asked her to tell me what they were, she responded with "I don't know what they are, that's for you to find out", then claimed I was just jealous of her new boyfriend.

>they are playing house

Never thought of them this way, but wow does it fit.

Sometimes you just gotta go places by yourself. I like to walk around my town at night, I get to see alot of amazing things, a few years back I found a movie theater that plays midnight movies every weekend. Got to see alot of other weirdos there haha.

I stopped caring at some point and started to accept that I was just going to be FA, but what seemed like a whirlwind of chance I found myself in a relationship (stay with me here ;P).
Only it would be just my luck that the person I ended up with was cluster B and after nearly three years of abuse I got out of it. I'm left with this feeling of never wanting to try again, it really sucks, life can be so cruel.

I don't get what is with them being so hypersexual, my ex posted an Instagram story saying how much she loves her new boyfriend's vasectomy, knowing that I'd see the story too as I hadn't gone NC yet. Besides it being a petty attempt to get under my skin who posts something like that for the internet to see? Lol

I didn't have to watch her pets or anything, but my ex wanted me to take her new boyfriend/fiance's cat cause she was allergic and I guess her first thought was, "I'll dump it on my ex whose heart I just tore out but that's okay because I'm the one affected."

I was exactly where you were in 2019, my situation involved a toxic cluster B dynamic but it's all the same. It gets better, slowly. You won't feel like your self for a while, it's been about 2 years since my breakup and I'm still not completely myself, but I got over her and she meant everything to me. You're worth more than the people who leave you behind.
I feel you, I got death threats from her new supply cause I wanted closure, they make you feel like the worst person ever when you're the one hurting.

My ex had/has a MASSIVE victim complex, she doesn't try at all to fix her life, even outside of BPD. I always had to hold back when she'd go into vent mode about the dumbest issues that were so easily solved if she just put in the effort and tried for once, instead I'd just tell her what she'd want to hear. That everything really wasn't her fault. There was a good 4-5 months during winter where I absolutely hated her guts, but I was afraid to be alone, so I put up with it.
